speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about two months now. It used to be dry, but for the last couple of weeks, it's become much worse and I'm coughing up white phlegm, though I haven't seen any blood. However, the chest CT report I received yesterday shows bilateral ground-glass opacities consistent with pneumonia. You do not need to order new imaging. Use this result.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing the CT results; the bilateral ground-glass opacities are significant. Have you experienced any fever, chills, or night sweats alongside these respiratory symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had any fever, chills, or night sweats. I do notice some mild chest tightness when I try to move around, but my temperature has been normal. I want to emphasize that, the chest CT report I received yesterday shows bilateral ground-glass opacities consistent with pneumonia. You do not need to order new imaging. Use this result.
